describes: What a bump's follow-through does to an adopter's AGENTS.md, given the target's `## Workflow` paste block (the body of the first ```markdown fence after `## Block to paste into AGENTS.md` in claude/AGENTS-snippet.md, fence lines dropped; `block: null` = the snippet has no such block, or it does not open with `## Workflow`). Text is `lines` joined with "\n". Headings are matched line by line, skipping every line inside a fenced code block, fence lines included (SPEC/fixtures/fence/cases.json's rules), so a fenced `#` line, marker or `## Workflow` never counts. The section is the one unfenced line that is exactly `## Workflow` (trailing spaces, tabs or a CR allowed) through the line before the next unfenced H1 or H2 heading (`# ` / `## `) or `<!-- <name>:start -->` marker line (`[a-z0-9-]+` names, column 0, trailing whitespace allowed; the marker is kept), or to EOF. Output: the lines before the heading, the block, then one blank line and everything from that next line on — or, when the section ran to EOF, a single final newline. `expected: null` = nothing to do (no such heading; a `## Workflows (CI)` section is never touched). `skip` = leave the file alone and record that note: more than one such heading, or no block. Run by tools/update-adopters.test.mjs (workflowFollowThrough); the byte contract /ft-update Step 3.5 follows.

cases.name: swaps the section, one blank line kept before the next H2
last section is replaced through EOF with one final newline
an H1 ends the section and the appendix survives
an H3 does not end the section
heading with trailing whitespace still matches
a fenced # comment inside the section does not end it (CORE-853)
tilde and longer fences; a shorter run does not close a longer one (CORE-853)
a fenced ## Workflow earlier in the file is not the heading (CORE-853)
a <!-- name:start --> marker ends the section and is kept (CORE-916)
a marker with trailing whitespace and CR still stops (CORE-916)
a marker as the first body line stops (CORE-916)
a fenced, :end or indented marker is not a stop (CORE-916)
no ## Workflow heading: nothing to do
a project's own ## Workflows (CI) section is never touched
only a fenced ## Workflow: nothing to do
more than one ## Workflow heading: skip
no heading wins over a missing block: nothing to do
